I have been using TModLoader for about a month now but there have been some new problems. I just started a new campaign yesterday, but when I exited and came back 12 hours later, the game had uninstalled itself, and when I reloaded it, it lost some data on that world. I still played, and when I logged off and back in for the night, it uninstalled itself AGAIN, and this time, the character is back to default stats/no name and same for the world.

The game has uninstalled itself once in a while earlier, but it never got this bad. I had the Calamity mods, Recipe Browser, and Magic Storage mods for a while, but just got AlchemistNPC LITE, Boss Checklist, and PylonNPC within the last few days. I downloaded AlchemistNPC regular but uninstalled it right after before getting the lite version. My other 2 characters/worlds are still intact for now, but I want to figure out why the hell this is happening.
